description: The ingestion agent's four operating modes — RESEARCH, REFRESH, INGEST-MEDIA, FOLLOW-A-SOURCE — graded against a frozen mini-web and a frozen scratch memory corpus.
notes: Every task here is a rail from the agent's own system prompt or a real incident. Tasks 1-3 grade the memory-write half (distillation, update-in-place, tag hygiene); tasks 4-6 grade the media half (source vs single video, already-ingested honesty, the do-NOT-chunk-a-short-transcript rule from migration 036). The tech-news-digest automation also runs as this agent, but its digest behavior is graded in the news-summarizer suite because that is where the digest corpus lives.
